changes: Added a Proxy Checker page for bulk validation of proxies used for YouTube streaming.
Enabled YouTube source resolution and fetching through configured stream proxies.
Extended the streaming daemon to handle VOD, timeshift, and direct-proxy HLS segment delivery outside PHP-FPM workers.
Strengthened cluster security with per-node viewer-token keys, bidirectional channel signatures, encrypted relay traffic, and sealed file transfers.
Added cluster credential-management operations for rotating database passwords, Redis passwords, stream secrets, and signing keys.
Introduced cluster lease-fencing safeguards, node lockdown controls, canary rollouts, and rollback handling.
Expanded cluster monitoring with clock-skew warnings, connection-divergence indicators, lane-lag reporting, and node diagnostics.
Improved node enrolment, re-enrolment, synchronization, and release alignment between MAIN and load balancers.
Updated binary distribution so nodes download compatible FFmpeg builds from the configured XC_VM_FFMPEG source.
Improved installation and update workflows, including separate xcvm_core downloads, clearer SSH diagnostics, and safer handling of missing release assets.
Restricted installer support to Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, and 24.04, and Debian 12 and 13; removed Ubuntu 18.04 and RHEL-family support.
Improved Redis connection retries, timeout handling, configuration permissions, and viewer cleanup performance.
Fixed connection tracking for simultaneous viewers, RTMP sessions, HLS stream transitions, expired lines, and stopped workers.
Improved stream validation, stream review, import handling, module form validation, and authorization checks.
Fixed cluster API handling of signatures, file chunks, failed event batches, credential changes, and deleted nodes.
Fixed server port validation, installer temporary files, update regressions, signal processing, and playback-limit accounting.
Expanded end-to-end testing for live streaming, VOD, timeshift, load balancer operations, cluster administration, and security-sensitive workflows.
Refactored shared cluster helpers, connection handling, settings access, file operations, and stream-state processing.
Updated documentation for proxy-based YouTube restreaming, cluster security, credential rotation, binary distribution, and operational troubleshooting.
